passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.1
passages.text: Pertimui, scriptumque tuum sine murmure legi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.2
passages.text: Iuraret ne quos inscia lingua deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.3
passages.text: Et, puto, captasses iterum, nisi, ut ipse fateris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.4
passages.text: Promissam scires me satis esse semel.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.5
passages.text: Nec lectura fui, sed, si tibi dura fuissem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.6
passages.text: Aucta foret saevae forsitan ira deae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.7
passages.text: Omnia cum faciam, cum dem pia tura Dianae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.8
passages.text: Illa tamen iusta plus tibi parte favet,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.9
passages.text: Utque cupis credi, memori te vindicat ira;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.10
passages.text: Talis in Hippolyto vix fuit illa suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.11
passages.text: At melius virgo favisset virginis annis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.12
passages.text: Quos vereor paucos ne velit esse mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.13
passages.text: Languor enim causis non apparentibus haeret;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.14
passages.text: Adiuvor et nulla fessa medentis ope.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.15
passages.text: Quam tibi nunc gracilem vix haec rescribere quamque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.16
passages.text: Pallida vix cubito membra levare putas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.17
passages.text: Nunc timor accedit, ne quis nisi conscia nutrix

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.18
passages.text: Colloquii nobis sentiat esse vices.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.19
passages.text: Ante fores sedet haec quid agamque rogantibus intus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.20
passages.text: Ut possim tuto scribere, 'dormit,' ait.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.21
passages.text: Mox, ubi, secreti longi causa optima, somnus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.22
passages.text: Credibilis tarda desinit esse mora,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.23
passages.text: Iamque venire videt quos non admittere durum est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.24
passages.text: Excreat et dicta dat mihi signa nota.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.25
passages.text: Sicut erant, properans verba inperfecta relinquo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.26
passages.text: Et tegitur trepido littera coepta sinu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.27
passages.text: Inde meos digitos iterum repetita fatigat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.28
passages.text: Quantus sis nobis adspicis ipse labor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.29
passages.text: Quo peream si dignus eras, ut vera loquamur;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.30
passages.text: Sed melior iusto quamque mereris ego.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.31
passages.text: Ergo te propter totiens incerta salutis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.32
passages.text: Commentis poenas doque dedique tuis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.33
passages.text: Haec nobis formae te laudatore superbae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.34
passages.text: Contingit merces? et placuisse nocet?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.35
passages.text: Si tibi deformis, quod mallem, visa fuissem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.36
passages.text: Culpatum nulla corpus egeret ope;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.37
passages.text: Nunc laudata gemo, nunc me certamine vestro

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.38
passages.text: Perditis, et proprio vulneror ipsa bono.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.39
passages.text: Dum neque tu cedis, nec se putat ille secundum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.40
passages.text: Tu votis obstas illius, ille tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.41
passages.text: Ipsa velut navis iactor quam certus in altum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.42
passages.text: Propellit Boreas, aestus et unda refert,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.43
passages.text: Cumque dies caris optata parentibus instat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.44
passages.text: Inmodicus pariter corporis ardor adest —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.45
passages.text: Ei mihi, coniugii tempus crudelis ad ipsum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.46
passages.text: Persephone nostras pulsat acerba fores!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.47
passages.text: Iam pudet, et timeo, quamvis mihi conscia non sim,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.48
passages.text: Offensos videar ne meruisse deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.49
passages.text: Accidere haec aliquis casu contendit, at alter

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.50
passages.text: Acceptum superis hunc negat esse virum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.51
passages.text: Neve nihil credas in te quoque dicere famam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.52
passages.text: Facta veneficiis pars putat ista tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.53
passages.text: Causa latet, mala nostra patent; vos pace movetis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.54
passages.text: Aspera submota proelia, plector ego!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.55
passages.text: Dic age nunc, solitoque tibi ne decipe more:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.56
passages.text: Quid facies odio, sic ubi amore noces?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.57
passages.text: Si laedis, quod amas, hostem sapienter amabis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.58
passages.text: Me, precor, ut serves, perdere, dire, velis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.59
passages.text: Aut tibi iam nulla est speratae cura puellae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.60
passages.text: Quam ferus indigna tabe perire sinis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.61
passages.text: Aut, dea si frustra pro me tibi saeva rogatur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.62
passages.text: Qua mihi te iactes, gratia nulla tua est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.63
passages.text: Elige, quid fingas: non vis placare Dianam —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.64
passages.text: Inmemor es nostri; non potes — illa tui est!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.65
passages.text: Vel numquam mallem vel non mihi tempore in illo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.66
passages.text: Esset in Aegaeis cognita Delos aquis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.67
passages.text: Tunc mea difficili deducta est aequore navis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.68
passages.text: Et fuit ad coeptas hora sinistra vias.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.69
passages.text: Quo pede processi! quo me pede limine movi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.70
passages.text: Picta citae tetigi quo pede texta ratis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.71
passages.text: Bis tamen adverso redierunt carbasa vento —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.72
passages.text: Mentior, a demens! ille secundus erat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.73
passages.text: Ille secundus erat qui me referebat euntem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.74
passages.text: Quique parum felix inpediebat iter.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.75
passages.text: Atque utinam constans contra mea vela fuisset —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.76
passages.text: Sed stultum est venti de levitate queri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.77
passages.text: Mota loci fama properabam visere Delon

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.78
passages.text: Et facere ignava puppe videbar iter.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.79
passages.text: Quam saepe ut tardis feci convicia remis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.80
passages.text: Questaque sum vento lintea parca dari!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.81
passages.text: Et iam transieram Myconon, iam Tenon et Andron,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.82
passages.text: Inque meis oculis candida Delos erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.83
passages.text: Quam procul ut vidi, 'quid me fugis, insula,' dixi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.84
passages.text: 'Laberis in magno numquid, ut ante, mari?'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.85
passages.text: Institeram terrae, cum iam prope luce peracta

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.86
passages.text: Demere purpureis sol iuga vellet equis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.87
passages.text: Quos idem solitos postquam revocavit ad ortus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.88
passages.text: Comuntur nostrae matre iubente comae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.89
passages.text: Ipsa dedit gemmas digitis et crinibus aurum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.90
passages.text: Et vestes umeris induit ipsa meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.91
passages.text: Protinus egressae superis, quibus insula sacra est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.92
passages.text: Flava salutatis tura merumque damus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.93
passages.text: Dumque parens aras votivo sanguine tingit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.94
passages.text: Sectaque fumosis ingerit exta focis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.95
passages.text: Sedula me nutrix altas quoque ducit in aedes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.96
passages.text: Erramusque vago per loca sacra pede.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.97
passages.text: Et modo porticibus spatior modo munera regum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.98
passages.text: Miror et in cunctis stantia signa locis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.99
passages.text: Miror et innumeris structam de cornibus aram,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.100
passages.text: Et de qua pariens arbore nixa dea est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.101
passages.text: Et quae praeterea — neque enim meminive libetve

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.102
passages.text: Quidquid ibi vidi dicere — Delos habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.103
passages.text: Forsitan haec spectans a te spectabar, Aconti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.104
passages.text: Visaque simplicitas est mea posse capi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.105
passages.text: In templum redeo gradibus sublime Dianae —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.106
passages.text: Tutior hoc ecquis debuit esse locus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.107
passages.text: Mittitur ante pedes malum cum carmine tali —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.108
passages.text: Ei mihi, iuravi nunc quoque paene tibi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.109
passages.text: Sustulit hoc nutrix mirataque 'perlege!' dixit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.110
passages.text: Insidias legi, magne poeta, tuas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.111
passages.text: Nomine coniugii dicto confusa pudore,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.112
passages.text: Sensi me totis erubuisse genis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.113
passages.text: Luminaque in gremio veluti defixa tenebam —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.114
passages.text: Lumina propositi facta ministra tui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.115
passages.text: Inprobe, quid gaudes? aut quae tibi gloria parta est?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.116
passages.text: Quidve vir elusa virgine laudis habes?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.117
passages.text: Non ego constiteram sumpta peltata securi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.118
passages.text: Qualis in Iliaco Penthesilea solo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.119
passages.text: Nullus Amazonio caelatus balteus auro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.120
passages.text: Sicut ab Hippolyte, praeda relata tibi est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.121
passages.text: Verba quid exultas tua si mihi verba dederunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.122
passages.text: Sumque parum prudens capta puella dolis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.123
passages.text: Cydippen pomum, pomum Schoeneida cepit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.124
passages.text: Tu nunc Hippomenes scilicet alter eris!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.125
passages.text: At fuerat melius, si te puer iste tenebat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.126
passages.text: Quem tu nescio quas dicis habere faces,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.127
passages.text: More bonis solito spem non corrumpere fraude;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.128
passages.text: Exoranda tibi, non capienda fui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.129
passages.text: Cur, me cum peteres, ea non profitenda putabas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.130
passages.text: Propter quae nobis ipse petendus eras?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.131
passages.text: Cogere cur potius quam persuadere volebas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.132
passages.text: Si poteram audita condicione capi?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.133
passages.text: Quid tibi nunc prodest iurandi formula iuris

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.134
passages.text: Linguaque praesentem testificata deam?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.135
passages.text: Quae iurat, mens est. sed nil iuravimus illa;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.136
passages.text: Illa fidem dictis addere sola potest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.137
passages.text: Consilium prudensque animi sententia iurat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.138
passages.text: Et nisi iudicii vincula nulla valent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.139
passages.text: Si tibi coniugium volui promittere nostrum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.140
passages.text: Exige polliciti debita iura tori;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.141
passages.text: Sed si nil dedimus praeter sine pectore vocem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.142
passages.text: Verba suis frustra viribus orba tenes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.143
passages.text: Non ego iuravi — legi iurantia verba;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.144
passages.text: Vir mihi non isto more legendus eras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.145
passages.text: Decipe sic alias — succedat epistula pomo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.146
passages.text: Si valet hoc, magnas ditibus aufer opes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.147
passages.text: Fac iurent reges sua se tibi regna daturos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.148
passages.text: Sitque tuum toto quidquid in orbe placet!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.149
passages.text: Maior es hoc ipsa multum, mihi crede, Diana,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.150
passages.text: Si tua tam praesens littera numen habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.151
passages.text: Cum tamen haec dixi, cum me tibi firma negavi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.152
passages.text: Cum bene promissi causa peracta mei est,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.153
passages.text: Confiteor, timeo saevae Latoidos iram

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.154
passages.text: Et corpus laedi suspicor inde meum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.155
passages.text: Nam quare, quotiens socialia sacra parantur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.156
passages.text: Nupturae totiens languida membra cadunt?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.157
passages.text: Ter mihi iam veniens positas Hymenaeus ad aras

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.158
passages.text: Fugit, et a thalami limine terga dedit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.159
passages.text: Vixque manu pigra totiens infusa resurgunt

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.160
passages.text: Lumina, vix moto corripit igne faces.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.161
passages.text: Saepe coronatis stillant unguenta capillis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.162
passages.text: Et trahitur multo splendida palla croco.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.163
passages.text: Cum tetigit limen, lacrimas mortisque timorem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.164
passages.text: Cernit et a cultu multa remota suo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.167
passages.text: Et pudet in tristi laetum consurgere turba,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.168
passages.text: Quique erat in palla, transit in ora rubor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.165
passages.text: Proicit ipse sua deductas fronte coronas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.166
passages.text: Spissaque de nitidis tergit amoma comis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.169
passages.text: At mihi, vae miserae! torrentur febribus artus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.170
passages.text: Et gravius iusto pallia pondus habent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.171
passages.text: Nostraque plorantes video super ora parentes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.172
passages.text: Et face pro thalami fax mihi mortis adest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.173
passages.text: Parce laboranti, picta dea laeta pharetra,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.174
passages.text: Daque salutiferam iam mihi fratris opem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.175
passages.text: Turpe tibi est, illum causas depellere leti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.176
passages.text: Te contra titulum mortis habere meae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.177
passages.text: Numquid, in umbroso cum velles fonte lavari,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.178
passages.text: Inprudens vultus ad tua labra tuli,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.179
passages.text: Praeteriive tuas de tot caelestibus aras,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.180
passages.text: Ave mea spreta est vestra parente parens?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.181
passages.text: Nil ego peccavi, nisi quod periuria legi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.182
passages.text: Inque parum fausto carmine docta fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.183
passages.text: Tu quoque pro nobis, si non mentiris amorem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.184
passages.text: Tura feras; prosint, quae nocuere, manus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.185
passages.text: Cur, qui succenses quod adhuc tibi pacta puella

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.186
passages.text: Non tua sit, fieri ne tua possit, agis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.187
passages.text: Omnia de viva tibi sunt speranda; quid aufert

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.188
passages.text: Saeva mihi vitam, spem tibi diva mei?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.189
passages.text: Nec tu credideris illum, cui destinor uxor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.190
passages.text: Aegra superposita membra fovere manu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.191
passages.text: Adsidet ille quidem, quantum permittitur, ipse

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.192
passages.text: Sed meminit nostrum virginis esse torum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.193
passages.text: Iam quoque nescio quid de me sensisse videtur;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.194
passages.text: Nam lacrimae causa saepe latente cadunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.195
passages.text: Et minus audacter blanditur et oscula rara

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.196
passages.text: Applicat et timido me vocat ore suam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.197
passages.text: Nec miror sensisse, notis cum prodar apertis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.198
passages.text: In dextrum versor, cum venit ille, latus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.199
passages.text: Nec loquor, et tecto simulatur lumine somnus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.200
passages.text: Captantem tactus reicioque manum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.201
passages.text: Ingemit et tacito suspirat pectore, meque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.202
passages.text: Offensam, quamvis non mereatur, habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.203
passages.text: Ei mihi, quod gaudes, et te iuvat ista voluntas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.204
passages.text: Ei mihi, quod sensus sum tibi fassa meos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.205
passages.text: At mihi siqua foret, tu nostra iustius ira,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.206
passages.text: Qui mihi tendebas retia, dignus eras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.207
passages.text: Scribis, ut invalidum liceat tibi visere corpus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.208
passages.text: Es procul a nobis, et tamen inde noces.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.209
passages.text: Mirabar quare tibi nomen Acontius esset;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.210
passages.text: Quod faciat longe vulnus, acumen habes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.211
passages.text: Certe ego convalui nondum de vulnere tali,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.212
passages.text: Ut iaculo scriptis eminus icta tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.213
passages.text: Quid tamen huc venias? sane miserabile corpus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.214
passages.text: Ingenii videas magna tropaea tui!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.215
passages.text: Concidimus macie; color est sine sanguine, qualem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.216
passages.text: In pomo refero mente fuisse tuo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.217
passages.text: Candida nec mixto sublucent ora rubore.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.218
passages.text: Forma novi talis marmoris esse solet;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.219
passages.text: Argenti color est inter convivia talis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.220
passages.text: Quod tactum gelidae frigore pallet aquae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.221
passages.text: Si me nunc videas, visam prius esse negabis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.222
passages.text: 'Arte nec est,' dices, 'ista petita mea,'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.223
passages.text: Promissique fidem, ne sim tibi iuncta, remittes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.224
passages.text: Et cupies illud non meminisse deam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.225
passages.text: Forsitan et facies iurem ut contraria rursus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.226
passages.text: Quaeque legam mittes altera verba mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.227
passages.text: Sed tamen adsideas utinam, quod et ipse rogabas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.228
passages.text: Et videas sponsae languida membra tuae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.229
passages.text: Durius ut ferro iam sit tibi pectus, Aconti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.230
passages.text: Tu veniam nostris vocibus ipse petas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.231
passages.text: Ne tamen ignores ope qua revalescere possim,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.232
passages.text: Quaeritur a Delphis fata canente deo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.233
passages.text: Is quoque nescio quam, nunc ut vaga fama susurrat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.234
passages.text: Neclectam queritur teste sorore fidem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.235
passages.text: Hoc deus, hoc vates, hoc edita carmina dicunt —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.236
passages.text: A! desunt voto numina nulla tuo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.237
passages.text: Unde tibi favor hic? nisi si nova forte reperta est

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.238
passages.text: Quae capiat magnos littera lecta deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.239
passages.text: Teque tenente deos numen sequor ipsa deorum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.240
passages.text: Doque libens victas in tua vota manus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.241
passages.text: Fassaque sum matri deceptae foedera linguae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.242
passages.text: Lumina fixa tenens plena pudoris humo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.243
passages.text: Cetera cura tua est; plus hoc quoque virgine factum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.244
passages.text: Non timuit tecum quod mea charta loqui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.245
passages.text: Iam satis invalidos calamo lassavimus artus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.246
passages.text: Et manus officium longius aegra negat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.247
passages.text: Quid, nisi, quod cupio me iam coniungere tecum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 21.248
passages.text: Restat, ut adscribat littera nostra: Vale?
